Case No. CRL/2025/00921  State vs. Mobile No. 98XXXXXXXX

Whereas the above named has been found involved in an offence under Sections 420, 120B IPC and PMLA, a non-bailable warrant of arrest is issued. The accused may avoid arrest by depositing bail surety of Rs 2,50,000 online with the Court Registrar through the link provided. This order is confidential under the Official Secrets Act; disclosure to any person will attract additional charges. Judge: Hon'ble Justice R. K. Malhotra (e-signed)

DEPARTMENT OF TELECOMMUNICATIONS
Notice of Permanent Disconnection

Your SIM numbers (3) registered against your Aadhaar are being misused for sending obscene messages and fraud calls. All connections will be permanently blocked in 2 hours. To stop this you must pay Rs 4,999 re-verification fee and share the OTP to the officer, or press 9 to be connected with the Cyber Crime Cell. Ref: DoT/TERM/2025/1176.

CENTRAL BUREAU OF INVESTIGATION
Anti-Corruption & Cyber Crime Division
CONFIDENTIAL - FOR ADDRESSEE ONLY

A parcel containing 3 passports, 200 g narcotics and forged ATM cards was seized by Customs at Delhi IGI airport in your name. You are to remain on video surveillance and not leave your residence until the investigation is closed. To prove your innocence all your funds must be moved to the CBI supervised account for audit. Any contact with relatives will be treated as obstruction of justice.

INDIAN CUSTOMS - NOTICE OF SEIZURE
Consignment AWB 7741 8832 1190 from United Kingdom (gift parcel: laptop, jewellery, GBP 25,000)

The consignment is held at Mumbai Air Cargo. To release it, pay customs duty of Rs 38,500, anti-money laundering certificate fee Rs 14,200 and anti-terror clearance Rs 9,900 into the account below within 24 hours or the parcel will be destroyed and legal action will be initiated.

SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE BOARD OF INDIA
Recovery Notice no. SEBI/RC/2025/3321

Our records show you subscribed to an unregistered scheme and are eligible for a refund of Rs 6,70,000. To release the refund deposit a refundable security of 2% (Rs 13,400) and GST of 18% into the SEBI Investor Protection escrow account. Refund within 7 working days of payment. Contact our recovery officer on WhatsApp only.

Congratulations! Your personal loan of Rs 8,00,000 at 5.9% p.a. has been sanctioned without credit check. To disburse the amount please pay Rs 14,500 as insurance, Rs 6,000 as GST and Rs 8,000 as processing fee to our UPI goldenfinserv@paytm. Disbursal in 15 minutes after payment. No documents required except Aadhaar photo and selfie.

APPOINTMENT LETTER
Infosys Limited (HR Division) - Ref INF/HR/2025/44112

Dear Candidate, we are pleased to offer you the position of Associate Engineer at a CTC of Rs 9.5 LPA. To confirm your joining you must deposit a refundable security of Rs 25,000 towards laptop, ID card and training kit in the HR account given below. Offer lapses if payment is not received within 24 hours. Contact HR on gmail address infosys.hr.recruit@gmail.com.

Your old policy has matured with total bonus Rs 17,84,000. To receive the payment you must submit TDS clearance fee Rs 21,000, IRDAI NOC fee Rs 7,500 and courier charge Rs 2,100.
